sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 52 (#51) and Internal Quality Checks row 52 (#51, 'both TOML families'; no cell comments)
task/solution/app/server.js, package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.mjs, public/index.html, public/assets/index.js
evidence: All checks run against the frozen snapshot .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task. (1) TOML: Python tomllib parses task.toml, tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml files without error; criterion counts 1 render, 2 constraints, 38 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual; no duplicate criterion ids in any file. (2) Shell: `bash -n` exits 0 for solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh; both start with `#!/bin/bash` (solve.sh:1, test.sh:1). A byte scan of all 43 task files found no CRLF, no UTF-8 BOM, no non-UTF-8 file and no missing final newline. tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile and tests/.dockerignore are identical to the frozen template (test.sh compared after CR normalisation of the template copy, the others byte-for-byte). (3) Python helpers: py_compile succeeds for score.py and restart_mcp.py. (4) Seed/JSON: environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json parse as JSON. (5) Reference entry: `node --check` passes for solution/app/server.js (Node v24.19.0 locally; image is node:22). server.js requires only node:fs, node:path, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5); both third-party modules are installed globally in the agent image (environment/Dockerfile:9-11, NODE_PATH line 3) and the verifier image (tests/Dockerfile:20-21, NODE_PATH line 9), and test.sh sets NODE_PATH at lines 106 and 162, so the entry resolves without a shipped node_modules or a solve-time install. solve.sh copies the app with `cp -a` and asserts server.js exists; test.sh launches /app/server.js (test.sh:68,97,111). The prebuilt client bundle public/assets/index.js passes `node --check` and contains no static or dynamic bare-specifier imports; public/index.html references /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, both shipped; vite.config.mjs passes `node --check`. src/custom-editor.js fails `node --check` only because it is ESM bundler input under a commonjs package.json; it is not an entry point and is not executed by the server, so this is not a defect. Run evidence: the hash-verified raw-evidence-index.json records a scripted golden run in which the server started, served requests and survived a real process restart (results/restart.json shows revision 2 with history [2,1]). That run predates the visual Likert-anchor line edit, which only touched tests/scored/visual/judge.toml; that file parses here. Limits: no Docker image build and no execution of solve.sh or test.sh inside the configured verifier was performed or evidenced in this round, and the bundle was not rebuilt from src to confirm it is current; those belong to the runtime/verifier rows and are not claimed here. Reviewer disclosure: my py_compile call briefly created tests/tools/__pycache__ (two .pyc files) inside the frozen snapshot; I removed it immediately and the snapshot is back to its 43 original files with no source byte changed. The owner may wish to re-verify the input hash.
